Title: Meeting with Customs Officer – BIS Certification & IS 616:2017 Scope Clarification
Remarks:
Meeting with Customs Officer – BIS Certification & IS 616:2017 Scope Clarification


Discussion Points
 
a. Product ExplanationDetailed      description of Neat Bar Gen 2 was provided to officer, including its      intended use as an enterprise video‑conferencing endpoint.Clarified      that the Bar functions in tandem with the Neat Pad (codec/controller),      forming a single system for conferencing applications.Emphasized      that the product is not designed for entertainment or media playback, but      strictly for real‑time communication.
b. BIS Legality and CertificationExplained      that the Neat Pad already holds BIS certification.BIS has      confirmed that the Pad + Bar are treated as a unit, hence separate      BIS registration for the Bar is not required.
c. Scope of IS 616:2017Discussed      that IS 616:2017 does not explicitly exclude conferencing bars.However,      its scope is defined by intended function, namely reception,      recording, or reproduction of audio/video content.Since      Neat Bar Gen 2 does not perform these functions, it falls outside the      scope of IS 616:2017.
 
Custom Officer’s PositionThe      officer acknowledged the technical explanation and agreed that the product      is primarily for communication, not entertainment.He      indicated that he is technically convinced of the argument.He      requested a formal written justification citing the scope of IS      616:2017 and clarifying its non‑applicability to conferencing bars, to      complete the compliance file.
 
Action ItemsImport      Team : To submit a formal justification letter referencing IS      616:2017 scope and statutory notifications, confirming non‑applicability      to Neat Bar Gen 2.Customs      Officer: To review the submitted justification and proceed with      clearance upon receipt of the final document.
 
Conclusion
The meeting concluded with mutual understanding. The officer is satisfied with the technical and legal explanation but requires a final written note citing IS 616:2017 scope to formally close the matter.
